title: The member footer is the header's mega menu upside down: area tabs pinned between the rail docks, each opening its panel upward
detail: Daniel 2026-10-20, after LIVE-1115 shipped a single Site index pop-up: 'The footer should be just like a mega menu. Bunch of tabs, that pop open into nav areas. Except this is upside down so it pops up. The left and right menus ALWAYS stay pinned to the bottom. The middle of the mega menu opens up on activation.' and 'There's no site index button. Make the menu look good like the top one. Follow the design system.' FqMegaFooter is now a glass tab bar fixed to the window bottom between the rail docks (mega-footer-tabs.tsx), one tab per registry footer column in the member header's nav-pill style, each opening its panel upward in the header's light mega-menu style with a glyph per destination, the serif foot line and the pastel call to action. The footer box is a 24px strip, so the rails end where they ride and the docks never move (measured 24px from the window bottom mid-page and at the page end). Phone: the tabs end the page and a panel rises as a sheet above the tab bar. Escape, outside click, a link and a navigation close a panel; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move along the bar.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const f=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/shared/mega-footer.tsx','utf8');const t=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/shared/mega-footer-tabs.tsx','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/mega-footer.css','utf8');if(/popover|Site index<\/button>|<details/.test(f+t))bad.push('the footer is a lone index button or an inline panel again');if(!/columns\.map\([\s\S]{0,400}<button/.test(t)||!t.includes('aria-controls={panelId(i)}'))bad.push('the bar is not one tab per area');if(!t.includes('ap-mega-foot')||!c.includes('var(--fq-pa)'))bad.push('the panel does not wear the header mega menu');if(!/\.fq-mf-dock\{position:fixed;[^}]*bottom:24px/.test(c))bad.push('the bar is not pinned to the window bottom with the docks');if(!/\.fq-mf-mega\{position:fixed;[^}]*bottom:96px/.test(c))bad.push('a panel does not open upward out of the bar');if(!c.includes('.fq-mf{position:relative;height:24px'))bad.push('the footer box moves the docks at the page end');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1116: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the footer goes back to one index button or an inline panel, stops being one tab per area, stops wearing the header's mega menu, unpins from the window bottom, opens downward, or lets the page end move the docks. Behavior is mega-footer.test.tsx.
